metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Field's Italian book, Margery's twenty-six shillings, and an hour at ten.

yesterday: Field asked whether the thing was written, rumoured, or known. You said you feared it. He took the Italian book and left the Holinshed lent.
Margery's twenty-six shillings are hers. Michaelmas is when the black gowns come back.
The Admiral's men are in Kent by now, or else the west.
Tomorrow at ten, at Clerkenwell. The book has been there since Monday.
